posts.name: Aryan Verma
posts.cooked: Its my first term of diploma level and in System Commands course’s dashboard, there is a video which gives guidance about how to login through the VM. I followed all the instructions. The instructor ran synchro show command and that was supposed to show some output but instead I got an error, why is it like that? Please help.

posts.name: Mrinal
posts.cooked: Please add screenshots of your terminal where you got that error. Will be easier for people here to indentify the problem and help you with it.

posts.name: Aryan Verma
posts.cooked:
Hey man thnx for replying, really needed help……according to the grading document my first BPT will be on 20 feb (tomorrow), so if u have any idea pl tell when will be the last date of submitting that BPT-1 test……also here is the screenshot (its not letting me put more than 1 screenshot)…..as u can see if i ran synchro show, it showing an error……pl tell how to fix ts, if u need more info, i will tell

image797×698 137 KB

posts.name: Mrinal
posts.cooked:
It’s not working because we do not have any assignment named assignment_0. Synchro show will only work for the assignments that are there in ther /opt/se2001 directory.

you can make any of these directories and it will work.

image717×480 137 KB

posts.name: Aryan Verma
posts.cooked: ok….but which of those directories contains the BPT-1 questions? also pl tell whats the deadline of BPT-1?

posts.name: Sarthak Jalota
posts.cooked: BPT1 has not yet been released. It will be released tomorrow. Check after 12-18hr on your VM.

posts.name: Swati Jain
posts.cooked:
25f2004123:

deadline of BPT-1

1 week from the date of released. Check your mail tomorrow for BPT 1 deadline.

posts.name: Aryan Verma
posts.cooked:
So….in that tutorial, i did all the steps he told to do and then, i had to run that last command….after that the files (or whatever they are) shown are a little diff from the files that he got (after he ran that similar command)……in his case he had smth like “hello.txt” and “script.sh” files which wasnt shown to me, some of the files shown to me (like that “init.sh” , “public” and “private”) werent shown to him…..pl tell what to do coz after that i was supposed to run the command “md5sum hello.txt” but after executing that command, it says thats there no such file as “hello.txt”……

posts.name: Mrinal
posts.cooked: ls justs lists the files inside the current directory. In the video it listed the files of that persons directory, which can be different from the now files which are present in your directory.
